title: Zhongtong Bus Premium Service Campaign in Algeria
summary: The Zhongtong Bus service team walked into Algeria, launching special visits and training to build a solid foundation for overseas service in North Africa.
content:
To improve the operation and service levels of overseas vehicles, and to strengthen customers' practical operation and maintenance capabilities, the Zhongtong Bus service team walked into Algeria, launching a journey of special visits and training to build a solid foundation for overseas service.

The footprint of this training spread across core cities such as Algiers, Oran and Annaba. Focusing on local drivers and maintenance teams, and centering on core pain points such as vehicle operation, daily maintenance and troubleshooting, the team conducted face-to-face communication and heart-to-heart service, accurately docking with every single need to make operations smoother and clients more reassured.

## Precise Empowerment with Tailored Training

Zhongtong Premium Service provides precise empowerment, creating exclusive training courses and customized maintenance plans that hit demands directly and are implemented efficiently. For drivers, combined with local operating conditions, the team explained operating specifications through case analyses and on-site practical operations, teaching operations hand-in-hand and passing on techniques point-to-point.

For maintenance teams, the focus was on systematic diagnostics and preventive maintenance. The training reinforced the complete process from fault identification to parts replacement, ensuring that local teams can independently handle daily service and keep the fleet running at peak performance. This campaign marks another solid step for Zhongtong's global service network in North Africa.
